systems.owner: Registrar of Businesses (the Registrar of Companies)
systems.tiers: kept on computer at the Registrar's office; the Act gives every public sector agency, a list that includes a local authority, online access to registration particulars and has the Registrar share business information with them through it
the Registrar's electronic system for applications, notifications and fees; prescribed public sector agencies are to forward permits and licences to it electronically

note: A statute: it entitles public sector agencies, local authorities among them, to online access to the business register, but states nothing about whether any local authority's office is connected or uses it. A law places nothing, so no fact is taken.
